events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost one of music's most unforgettable voices. Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago today, a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Revolutionary Sound
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul' - an album that truly changed the game. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years On

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the music world lost John Lennon, a visionary who would have been 86 today. His legacy continues to inspire.

angles.name: Starman's Birthday
